label: Rooms
description: Rooms and indoor places in homes, workplaces, shops, dining venues, public buildings, and imagined settings.
notes: Rooms and indoor places belong here, including vehicle cabins, public facilities, and speculative interiors. Values are noun phrases with an article and concrete layout or fixture details; interior_space.style owns decorative style and interior_space.tidiness owns cleanliness, clutter, and signs of abandonment. Kind groups describe use and may overlap, while size describes usable room scale. Era and genre restrict incompatible historical or speculative settings; surviving architecture and revival furnishings remain available in contemporary scenes.
